rooks useDebouncedValue.description:
Debounce a value; the second element writes the debounced value immediately, bypassing the wait. Requires useDebouncedValue from rooks.

防抖一个值；返回的第二项可立即写入防抖值，跳过等待。需要从 rooks 导入 useDebouncedValue。

rooks useDebounceFn.description:
Create a debounced callback and a flag telling whether a call is pending. This returns a tuple, unlike the ahooks hook of the same name which returns an object with run, cancel and flush. Requires useDebounceFn from rooks.

创建防抖回调，并返回是否有调用待执行的标记；它返回数组，与 ahooks 同名 Hook 返回含 run / cancel / flush 的对象不同。需要从 rooks 导入 useDebounceFn。

rooks useThrottle (throttled callback).description:
Throttle a callback so it runs at most once per interval. This throttles a callback, unlike the ahooks and react-use hooks of the same name which throttle a value. Requires useThrottle from rooks.

节流回调，使其在每个间隔内至多执行一次；它节流的是回调，与 ahooks、react-use 同名 Hook 节流值不同。需要从 rooks 导入 useThrottle。

rooks useToggle.description:
Manage a boolean with a toggle. Requires useToggle from rooks.

以 toggle 管理布尔值；需要从 rooks 导入 useToggle。

body: const { value: ${1:count}, increment, decrement, incrementBy, reset } = useCounter(${2:0});
rooks useCounter.description:
Manage a numeric counter with by-amount actions. This returns an object keyed value, unlike the usehooks-ts hook of the same name which keys it count, and unlike the ahooks and react-use hooks which return a tuple. Requires useCounter from rooks.

管理数值计数器，并提供按量增减；它返回对象且键名为 value，与 usehooks-ts 同名 Hook 的 count 不同，也与 ahooks、react-use 返回数组不同。需要从 rooks 导入 useCounter。

rooks useLocalstorageState.description:
Persist state to localStorage, with a remover. Note the lowercase s in Localstorage, which differs from the ahooks hook useLocalStorageState. Requires useLocalstorageState from rooks and a browser environment.

将状态持久化到 localStorage 并提供清除函数；注意 Localstorage 中的小写 s，与 ahooks 的 useLocalStorageState 拼写不同。需要从 rooks 导入 useLocalstorageState，并运行在浏览器环境。

rooks useOutsideClickRef.description:
Get a ref to attach to an element; the handler runs on clicks outside it. This hands back a ref rather than accepting one, unlike the equivalents in ahooks, react-use and usehooks-ts. Requires useOutsideClickRef from rooks.

取得一个挂到元素上的 ref，点击其外部时执行回调；它是返回 ref 而非接收 ref，与 ahooks、react-use、usehooks-ts 的对应 Hook 相反。需要从 rooks 导入 useOutsideClickRef。

rooks useMediaMatch.description:
Track a CSS media query. Requires useMediaMatch from rooks.

跟踪 CSS 媒体查询；需要从 rooks 导入 useMediaMatch。

rooks useIntervalWhen.description:
Run a callback on an interval only while a condition holds, which replaces pausing by passing a null delay. Requires useIntervalWhen from rooks.

仅在条件成立期间按间隔执行回调，取代传 null 延时来暂停的写法；需要从 rooks 导入 useIntervalWhen。

rooks useKey.description:
Run a callback for the given keys. Requires useKey from rooks.

按下指定按键时执行回调；需要从 rooks 导入 useKey。

rooks useFreshCallback.description:
Keep a callback identity stable while it still sees current state. Requires useFreshCallback from rooks.

保持回调引用稳定，同时仍能读取当前状态；需要从 rooks 导入 useFreshCallback。
